moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ld-squares, written here): 2×2 grid (28 px pitch), three squares 22x22 r4 (one accent) and one empty slot. Every 0.6 s all three move one slot clockwise at once over the first 70 % of the step (0.42 s power2.inOut), so the empty slot travels too; 4 steps = 2.4 s cycle. (Recipe and data say one square at a time.) Params: step (0.6 s, di chuyển 0.42 s) · cycle (2.4 s) · square (22 px, cách 28) · ease (power2.inOut). All three squares move one slot clockwise at once, so the empty slot travels too.
